title: A multifunctional p-type additive for enhanced efficiency in perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1520-1524
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01811G, Paper
Liang Wang, Fengyang Yu, Shuzhang Yang, Xiaoyong Cai, Qianji Han, Qingqing Miao, Tingli Ma, Shuzi Hayase
C8BTBT enhances crystallinity, reduces nonradiative recombination, and optimizes energy alignment in perovskites, achieving 22.03% efficiency. This study provides insights for future research on functionalized materials in photovoltaics.
